_about: Ride counts (17/10/2026). Phones send anonymous open and finish ticks here. The counter is the Apps Script project "Ride Guide ride counter" bound to the Google Sheet "Ride Guide ride counts" (admin@elementoutdoors.com.au); its code is scripts/ride-counts.gs.
